items.title: 13.8.1 Aabi silver ion ke saath halides ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.8.1 with Figure 13.2, printed pages 297-298.

blocks.text: Na-halne wale silver halides tab bante hain jab halide ions aabi silver nitrate se react karein, X-(aq) + Ag+(aq) se AgX(s); yeh reactions qualitative analysis mein halide ions pehchanne ke liye istemal hote hain aur silver nitrate test kehlate hain. Fluoride ke saath koi reaction nazar nahi aata, kyunke silver fluoride pani mein halne wala hai. Silver aur chloride ions silver chloride ka safed precipitate dete hain, dilute ammonia mein halne wala: Ag+ + Cl- se AgCl(s). Silver aur bromide ions silver bromide ka cream rang ka precipitate dete hain, ghaliz ammonia mein thora halne wala: Ag+ + Br- se AgBr(s). Silver aur iodide ions silver iodide ka peela precipitate dete hain, ammonia mein na-halne wala: Ag+ + I- se AgI(s) (Figure 13.2).

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: fluoride, chloride, bromide aur iodide ke liye chaar test tubes jin mein koi precipitate nahi, safed, cream aur peela precipitate hai, har ek ke neeche ammonia ka nateeja aur muadle. Oopar daen: chlorine ke thande aur garam sodium hydroxide reactions har product mein chlorine ki oxidation states ke saath. Neeche: pani mein chlorine ki hydrolysis, HOCl aur OCl- kaise jaraseem maarte hain, aur pH, dose aur contact time ke awamil pH ki patti ke saath.
blocks.caption: Ammonia ke saath silver nitrate test, thande aur garam sodium hydroxide ke saath chlorine, aur pani ki chlorination (Figure 13.2, Table 13.6 aur topics 13.8 se 13.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Silver ions chloride ko safed silver chloride, bromide ko cream silver bromide aur iodide ko peele silver iodide ke taur par precipitate karte hain, jabke fluoride solution mein rehta hai; ammonia phir chloride ko dilute solution mein aur bromide ko sirf ghaliz solution mein hal karti hai, aur iodide ko chhorti nahi, jo har ion ko pehchanta hai. Chlorine alkali mein disproportionate hoti hai: thande dilute sodium hydroxide ke saath yeh chloride aur chlorate(I) deti hai, garam ghaliz alkali ke saath chloride aur chlorate(V), wahi element ek saath oxidise aur reduce hota hua. Pani mein chlorine hydrolyse ho kar hydrochloric aur chloric(I) acids deti hai; neutral HOCl molecule bacteria ki cell deewaron mein ghus kar un ke proteins, enzymes aur nucleic acids ko oxidise karta hai, to 6 aur 7.5 ke darmiyan pH par chlorination, kaafi dose aur contact time ke saath, peene ka pani sasta disinfect karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Aabi fluoride silver nitrate ke saath precipitate kyun nahi deta jabke doosre halides dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Silver fluoride pani mein halne wala hai, silver ke chloride, bromide aur iodide ke bar-aks, jin ke solubility products nanhe hain aur chloride se iodide tak girte hain. To Ag+ aur F- solution mein rehte hain aur kuch nazar nahi aata.

items: Ag+ + X- se AgX(s): F- kuch nahi (AgF halne wala); Cl- safed; Br- cream; I- peela. Silver nitrate test qualitative analysis mein halides pehchanta hai.
